fact: Business Daily reports that the implementation guidelines of the 2025 Kenya Cloud Policy, published by the Ministry of ICT and the Digital Economy, prohibit entities from hosting systems and data in their own server rooms without Cloud Adoption Committee authorisation and give all State organs 24 months to migrate non-exempted systems; the document gives no date for the guidelines other than its publication date, 2026-08-06.

Business Daily reports that applications for accreditation as a government cloud service provider are open to a Cloud Adoption Committee yet to be established, one provider will be chosen from the accredited list to host all State data, and the list of eligible providers is yet to be published; the document gives no date for this other than its publication date, 2026-08-06.

Digital Policy Alert records that the Secretary for Information Communication and Digital Economy signed the Kenya Cloud Policy, 2025 on 7 April 2025 and that it became effective on 2 May 2025 following publication in the Kenya Gazette.
Africa in the Room states that Kenya's Cloud Policy 2025 came into force in May 2025 and requires government data classified as sensitive, top secret, secret or restricted to be stored within Kenya.

fact: Tech Africa News reports the National Cloud Policy among the policy and regulatory reforms already achieved with Executive-Parliament collaboration, as told by the ICT State Department's Principal Secretary; the article gives no date for the policy, so its published date 2026-07-30 is used.
TechTrends Africa states that the Kenyan government's Cloud Policy, introduced in 2024, formally adopts a cloud-first approach for public sector organisations.

fact: Permanent Secretary Washington Okoth announced the official release of the Kenya Cloud Policy, which prioritises cloud-based ICT adoption and moves away from traditional on-premise data centres.

The Information, Communications and Digital Economy Cabinet Secretary said public bodies' cloud adoption is guided by the Kenya Cloud Policy 2025 and its implementation guidelines, under which institutions will classify data, buy only from accredited providers and migrate systems.
